# NovoTech Machine Tools Inc.

> Metalworking and metal fabrication machinery supplier in Mississauga, ON, Canada. Sells, installs and supports press brakes, laser cutters, shears, ironworkers, plate rollers, angle rolls, bandsaws, cold saws, rebar benders and cutters, pipe benders, hydraulic presses, punching machines, bevelers, deburring and finishing machines, corner grinders and corner welders, notchers, aluminum and PVC window and door machinery and press brake tooling. Machines are supplied with CSA-approved electrical panels and supported with spare parts and technical support from Canada.

Contact: +1 647 526 5510 · info (at) NovoTechMachineTools.com · 1365 Mid-Way Blvd, Unit 26, Mississauga, ON L5T 2J5, Canada.
NovoTech is appointing independent sales agents and dealers in cities and provinces across Canada; enquiries through the quote form on any product page or by phone.
Social: YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@NovoTechMachineTools · LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/novotech-machine-tools-inc/ · Facebook https://www.facebook.com/novotechmachinetoolscanada · Instagram https://www.instagram.com/novotech_machinetools/
Brands represented include GMS GöçMakSan (rebar machinery), Dener (press brakes, shears, lasers), Senfeng (fiber lasers, laser welders), ISITAN, Bekamak, Pilous, Gecam and Eurofintec, Plastmak, CKEMSA, LFSS, Cevisa and EUROSTAMP tooling.
